items.name: live wallpapers
items.note: Changing wallpaper slideshow (Desktop settings > change background every N minutes); animated video wallpapers are not built in - they cost too much CPU on 2-4 GB laptops

items.name: hibernate
items.note: :Hibernate needs a disk swap area as big as RAM; NAVIN uses compressed RAM (ZRAM) for speed, so hibernate is reported as unsupported. Sleep works

items.name: jump lists
items.note: Right-click an app in the Start menu for its actions (new window, private window); per-app recent-file jump lists do not exist in XFCE

items.name: VPN
items.note: WireGuard VPN works in Network Connections out of the box; OpenVPN needs the optional network-manager-openvpn-gnome package (App Store)

items.name: signed update metadata
items.note: Update files are checked with SHA-256 from the GitHub release over HTTPS; a separate signing key is not used yet

items.name: update history
items.note: Every applied update keeps a folder /var/backups/navin/<old>-<new> with the replaced files; there is no separate history window yet

items.name: Voice control
items.note: Offline voice search (English) opens results; full hands-free control of every window is not built

items.name: magnifier
items.note: Alt + mouse wheel zooms the whole screen while window effects are on; there is no separate magnifier window

items.name: high contrast
items.note: GTK's built-in HighContrast style (Appearance); not every app follows it

items.name: color filters
items.note: Night Light warm filter; colour-blind filters are not built in

items.name: cloud integration
items.note: Nextcloud/WebDAV, FTP, SMB and SFTP folders in Files > Other Locations; Google Drive/OneDrive accounts are not built in
